title: GrowthBook stats and deploy options (v2)
description: A diagonal violet-to-navy band: three big light-weight numbers with mono captions, each behind a thin hairline, then two large white cards side by side (icon, 48px heading, one line, violet button) whose left edge carries the gradient accent. Phones stack the numbers between hairlines and the cards one under the other.
notes: the band runs from the brand colour to navy; the white cards follow the theme's card colour
each card's icon is a media slot (placeholder when empty)
